caption: The video showcases a dark purple, near-black backdrop threaded with faint vertical light columns and a soft magenta glow in the upper-center. A dense field of small glowing particles drifts across the frame, mixing round pink, magenta and white bokeh dots with short vertically oriented streaks. The arrangement continuously reconfigures as dots and streaks shift downward, while the bright top-center cluster persists yet twinkles, its points dimming, flaring and sliding out of place. The central glow stays roughly fixed in location, its intensity and surrounding streak pattern subtly varying. The background columns remain broadly present, indicating a continuous backdrop. No particle clearly enters or exits at the edges, so the flow appears already ongoing at both boundaries.
